subject: Request: 3-week trial extension & pricing ask - Acme AI
messages:
From: Sam Bhatt <sam@acme.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Cc: Maya Lopez <maya@acme.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T13:12:00Z
Subject: Request: 3-week trial extension & pricing ask

Hi Karthik,

Quick context: we've been running the 2-week timeboxed eval of Redwood (search-ranking / rerank pipeline) and the team is happy with latency and initial relevance. We ran into two blockers this week:
- an unexpected integration lag on our side (third-party data transformation) that consumed ~30% of our pilot runway, and
- a burst of queries on an edge dataset we wanted to validate.

We'd like to request a 3-week extension to the current pilot so we can finish the integration and validate the larger dataset. Given the ask, procurement is also asking for a concession on pricing for the extension — they suggested a 20% discount for the additional weeks or an equivalent token credit.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood extend the pilot by 3 weeks and provide either a time-based extension or credits to cover the shortfall?
2) If we move to credits, would Redwood consider an additional 2 hours of concierge/engineering support to help speed the connector fix?

I've attached a small usage export that shows where the burn hit us (Acme_POC_usage.csv). Procurement would like a simple addendum we can sign.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Bhatt
Head of Integrations, Acme AI
Attachments: Acme_POC_usage.csv (text/csv)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
To: Sam Bhatt <sam@acme.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-08-03T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week trial extension & pricing ask

Sam — thanks for the note and the usage file. Glad the baseline performance is looking good.

High level, we can cover this with two straightforward options (we aim to keep the contract footprint minimal so procurement can sign quickly):

Option A (credit-first):
- Convert the equivalent of a 3-week capacity into a one-time token credit (we model this as ~N tokens based on your current burn).
- + 2 hours of concierge engineering (one-off) to help with the connector.
- No changes to the base pilot dates; credits are consumed until exhausted.

Option B (time-first):
- Extend the timeboxed pilot by 3 calendar weeks (same terms).
- Apply a 10% discount to the incremental weeks (applies only to the extended period).
- Include one weekly 1-hour check-in (concierge) during the extension.

Notes:
- We can do Option A immediately via an addendum that applies credits; Option B requires a short approval for the discount but should be doable. If procurement is pushing for 20% off, I need to escalate to finance — that we can do, but it will likely come with a requirement to trade for a short-term commitment or a reference/quote.

I'm attaching a quick worksheet with the two options and modeled token equivalence (karthik_options.xlsx). Tell me which you prefer and I will draft the addendum. Also let me know the procurement contact and target sign date.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: karthik_options.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Sam Bhatt <sam@acme.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Cc: Maya Lopez <maya@acme.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week trial extension & pricing ask

Thanks Karthik — that helps. Procurement would prefer a straightforward time extension (Option B) rather than credits, because our billing is aligned to runbooks. They are willing to accept a smaller discount if needed.

Counter-proposal: 3-week extension + 15% discount on the incremental weeks, plus the weekly 1-hour concierge check-in. We can commit to a signed addendum by next Tuesday (2026-08-10) if Redwood can confirm. No extra long-term commitment from our side — just this one addendum.

Can you confirm you can commit to 15% without escalating to finance? If not, tell me what you need from procurement (PO, short-term commit, reference).

Best,
Sam
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-08-05T10:45:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Acme extension request — internal note

Karthik — quick internal read: I saw Sam's 15% ask. Margin on three weeks at that level is tight but acceptable if we structure it as a strictly timeboxed addendum (no roll-forward) and swap some discount value into service hours rather than pure unit price reduction. Recommendation: approve 15% with the following guardrails:
- Discount applies only to the incremental weeks (explicit line in addendum).
- Addendum expires at end of extended period and does not change later pricing.
- Replace 5% of the discount with 2x 1-hour concierge sessions that we log as Professional Services credit (keeps cash impact lower).
- Require a target sign date (procurement) by 2026-08-10 or offer falls back to 10%.

If you want, I can draft the short internal approval note so finance can rubber-stamp it.

-Jordan
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
To: Sam Bhatt <sam@acme.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week trial extension & pricing ask

Sam — good news, we can accept your counter-proposal with the guardrails Jordan recommended. Final terms: 

- 3 calendar week extension to the current pilot (starts on the day after current pilot end).
- 15% discount on Redwood list price for the incremental weeks (applies only to the extended period).
- 2x 1-hour concierge engineering sessions during the extension (scheduled with your team).
- Addendum language: discount limited to this extension; credits do not roll forward; addendum must be countersigned by 2026-08-10.

I've attached a short Draft_Addendum.pdf that implements the above and includes a DocuSign link for signature: https://app.redwood.example/docusign/ACME-ADDENDUM-7432. If procurement signs by EOD today we will activate the extension immediately.

If procurement needs a PO or a single-line reference to a short-term commit, tell me who to loop and I will add the necessary clause (we prefer to avoid longer contracts for this one-off).

I'll also book the first concierge slot for next Wednesday — Marissa, can you coordinate the calendar with Acme?

Thanks — Karthik
Attachments: Draft_Addendum.pdf (application/pdf)
